scoringModel.name: collection-wide trait information score
scoringModel.formula: sum(log2(total metadata records / trait value count))

policy: Rarity never assigns a boss role automatically.
Only unminted metadata records are considered for game-controlled roles.
Surviving minted tokens remain player characters and burned tokens remain Burned Echoes.
